page_title: BRE 1-0 LYO | Brest v Lyon 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Marco Bizot anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
90+3' Brest hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Jonas Martin (Brest) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
90+1' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Bilal Brahimi (Brest) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes made a crucial save! Brest have a corner.
87' 1 - 0 Steve Mounie (Brest) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
87' Steve Mounie (Brest) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
86' The cross into the penalty area from Bilal Brahimi (Brest) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
84' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bilal Brahimi (Brest) replacing Jeremy Le Douaron.
83' Lyon couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
81' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lilian Brassier (Brest) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' The substitution is prepared. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alexandre Lacazette.
79' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and it's Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mahdi Camara and he is replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
76' Substitution. Jonas Martin (Brest) replaces Hugo Magnetti.
76' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

74' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Marco Bizot has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
72' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
72' Dangerous play by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon). Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brest.
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Martin Satriano as he is replaced by Steve Mounie (Brest).
70' A brilliant individual effort! Martin Satriano (Brest) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
67' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
64' Mahdi Camara (Brest) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
61' What a huge chance for Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
59' Bradley Locko (Brest) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
57' Anthony Lopes is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lilian Brassier (Brest). Easy save!
56' A wild pass somehow finds Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.

55' Excellent touch by Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
54' Mama Balde (Lyon) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
54' Total attempts – 15:1.
52' The substitution has been made. Tino Kadewere (Lyon) has replaced Diego Moreira.
52' That will be all from Paul Akouokou who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
51' Here is a change. Ernest Nuamah is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Mama Balde (Lyon).
50' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
50' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
48' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
42' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
42' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It will be a corner kick for Brest.
42' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
40' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.
37' Brest are ruled offside.
37' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
36' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brest.

35' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
35' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
35' Mahdi Camara (Brest) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Brest earn a corner.
33' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
33' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Brest will take a corner kick.
31' The foul by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
30' Bradley Locko (Brest) sends an accurate pass to Romain Del Castillo, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
28' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
26' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
25' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jeremy Le Douaron, but Anthony Lopes displays great awareness to stop him.
24' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.

24' OFF THE POST! Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:0.
21' The resulting corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) comes to nothing.
20' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
20' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes a direct free kick.

20' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle after Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Brest, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

18' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
18' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) steps up to send the ball in.
18' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Brest get a corner.
17' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
15' That was close by Romain Del Castillo (Brest)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
13' It could have been a good chance to score! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) fails to release Maxence Caqueret with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
12' The resulting corner, taken by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), comes to nothing.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.
10' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
7' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
5' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

5' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Anthony Lopes. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
4' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

2' That's unlucky! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
2' What a chance that is! Hugo Magnetti (Brest) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Leonard.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
